title: Sim Racing Telemetry
description: A live dashboard for driving and race timing telemetry. Built for Gran Turismo 7.
note: Opens straight into a demo session. Live data needs a small bridge program (linked on the page) running on your own network.

title: Gran Turismo Tuner
description: Share Gran Turismo 7 tunes as a link. Pick a car, fill in the tune, and anyone who opens the link gets it in the same editable form.
